content: फलकम् .²1 A board, plank, slab, tablet; कालः काल्या भुवनफलके कीडति प्राणिशारैः <ls>Bh. 3. 39</ls>; द्यूत˚, चित्र˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Any flat surface; चुम्ब्यमानकपोलफलकाम् <ls>K. 218</ls>; धृतमुग्धगण्डफलकैर्विबभुः <ls>Śi. 9. 47</ls>, <ls n="Śi. 9.">37</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> तट. .²3 A shield; <ls>Rām. 1</ls>. .²4 A slab, tablet, leaf or page for writing upon. .²5 The buttocks, hips. .²6 The palm of the hand. .²7 Fruit, result, consequence. .²8 Profit, gain. .²9 Menstruation. .²10 The head of an arrow. .²11 The pericarp of a lotus. .²12 A broad and flat bone (of the forehead). .²13 A wooden seat; तवार्हते तु फलकं कूर्चं वाऽप्यथवा बृसी <ls>Mb. 5. 35. 15</ls>. .²14 Bark (as material for clothes).
